==Description==
'''Midnight Issue''' is a map officially added in the [[v1.81.0]] update.

==Design & Path==
'''Midnight Issue''' is located on the table of a giant cabin in the woods. Through the exit to the outside, it is possible to see that the map takes place during Winter, as the ground is entirely covered in snow. Inside the cabin, there are various objects placed in it, like a bookshelf, fireplace, coat hanger, table and a few seats. Two doors, one open can be seen on the other side of the cabin and a hatch can be seen on the floor. On the walls of the cabin, there are also various shelves containing random props and multiple paintings, though all of them except one are just simple colors.

The entrance is an opened stood up lighter box with a scribble on the front of the box. The path is made out of blocky bricks, like in [[Toyboard]]. The path starts off straight and then does a 180 degree loop, to enter back into itself just like in [[Crossroads]], then takes one left turn, one right turn, and one final right turn and then into a straight line which leads to the exit. The exit is a cookie held up by several lego bricks.

==Rewards==
The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map.

Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal.

{{Rewards|Normal|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}}

==Strategy==
*The loop near the entrance is the ideal spot for most towers.
**The loop is a decent spot for the [[Ace Pilot]], due to it matching its circle path quite well.
**There is a small section of the path that crosses over one spot twice, which can be very useful for low range towers like the [[Assassin]], [[Slasher]] or [[Shotgunner]].
*Towers with higher range, like the [[Ranger]] or [[Necromancer]], should be placed around the center of the map, as their high range allows them to cover most or all of the path.

==Trivia==
*'''Midnight Issue''' was not mentioned anywhere in the [[v1.80.0]] update log, as it was added in an update early.
*An image of the [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/uncanny-cat Uncanny Cat] can be found peeking through one of the doors.
*On the fireplace, there are a few trophies, which include various Bloxy awards.
*While most paintings on the map are just simple colors, one of them above the fireplace has a mysterious figure with white glow coming out of it.
*This was the first and the only map to have {{Color|Medium}} difficulty.
**This is no longer the case as of [[v1.83.0|v1.83.7]], as the difficulty was reverted back to {{Color|Normal}}, meaning no map with such difficulty exists.
